criteria.name: Class Design
criteria.description: Proper OOP design with encapsulation, constructors, and appropriate access modifiers

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Private fields, public methods, multiple constructors (default + parameterized), proper encapsulation

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good encapsulation with minor issues (missing constructor overload)

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Basic class structure but encapsulation violations

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: Public fields or major design issues

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No class or completely incorrect structure

criteria.name: Core Methods
criteria.description: deposit(), withdraw(), and getBalance() work correctly

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All methods work correctly: deposit adds to balance, withdraw subtracts (with sufficient funds check), getBalance returns current balance

levels.label: Mostly Correct
levels.description: Methods work but missing overdraft protection or minor calculation errors

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Methods exist but have significant bugs

criteria.name: Validation & Error Handling
criteria.description: Validates input and handles error conditions appropriately

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Rejects negative deposits, prevents overdrafts, validates initial balance, throws or handles exceptions appropriately

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Most validation present but missing some edge cases

criteria.name: Code Quality
criteria.description: Clean code following Java conventions with documentation

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: JavaDoc comments, meaningful names, consistent formatting, follows Java naming conventions

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good quality with minor style issues

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Readable but inconsistent or minimal documentation

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: Hard to read, poor naming, no comments
